availability.statement: Crypto Yield access is plan and entitlement dependent; a 403 means this credential is not entitled to the requested capability.

common_pitfalls: Pool and platform codes are identifiers, not display names.
Omitting list filters can return large responses; filter whenever the codes are known.
Historical metrics require one pool code and support bounded date/resample parameters.
description: Crypto lending platforms, pools, latest ticks, and historical pool metrics.
ticker_format: Platform and pool codes, e.g. aavev2 and aavev2_usdc
workflows: List platforms first when the relevant platform code is unknown.
List or filter pools to discover the pool code required by historical metrics.
Use latest ticks for a bounded current view and one-pool metrics for historical analysis.
